site.name: Loop Audio
site.description: Loop Audio is a small San Francisco shop for headphones, speakers and the accessories that keep them working. Free US shipping over $75.

hero.headline: Hear the room before you buy the pair, in the showroom on Folsom Street
hero.sub: Twelve things we can stand behind, two of them our own. Every one is wired up and ready to play.

categories.label: Three shelves
categories.heading: What we sell
categories.sub: Four pairs of headphones, four speakers, four accessories. Nothing we have not listened to.

items.title: Free US shipping over $75
items.body: Flat $9 under that. Two to five business days anywhere in the US.

items.title: Thirty days to change your mind
items.body: Used or not, as long as you have the box. We pay the return shipping.

items.title: Two years of warranty
items.body: Three on the Loop-branded range. Keep the order number; that is all we ask for.

items.title: Stripe takes the payment
items.body: Card details never touch our servers.

reviews.label: What customers say
reviews.heading: Four people who bought from us

showroom.label: The room
showroom.heading: Come and listen on Folsom Street
showroom.body: Everything on this site is set up in the showroom. Bring the music you know best; the Harbour 500 is wired and waiting.
